requirements.requirement: Identify the insect that is loved and enjoyed by many people in African countries and is particularly known as a local delicacy in northern South Africa.
Establish that the same insect is known to have a habit of burrowing underground to pupate.
Establish that the same insect is over-harvested and can be very expensive to buy.
Establish that a harvesting project was started in the early 2010s for this insect to benefit the people who eat it and those who sell it.
Identify the article published in the 2010s that contains a quotation stating that this insect is a good source of protein.
Identify the person who was quoted in that article as stating that this insect is a good source of protein.
